dataModels.name: Employee
dataModels.description: Central data model containing employee personal information, contact details, and onboarding status for the employee onboarding system

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the employee

fields.name: firstName
fields.description: Employee's first name

fields.name: lastName
fields.description: Employee's last name

fields.name: email
fields.description: Employee's work email address

fields.name: phoneNumber
fields.description: Employee's primary contact phone number

fields.name: startDate
fields.description: Employee's official start date

fields.name: position
fields.description: Employee's job title or position

fields.name: onboardingStatus
fields.description: Current status of employee onboarding process (e.g., pending, in-progress, completed)

dataModels.name: EquipmentCatalog
dataModels.description: Master catalog of equipment configurations and standard packages for different roles and departments

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the equipment package

fields.name: packageName
fields.description: Name of the equipment package (e.g., 'Developer Standard', 'Sales Executive')

fields.name: role
fields.description: Target role for this equipment package

fields.name: department
fields.description: Department this package is designed for

fields.name: equipmentItems
fields.description: List of equipment items included in the package with specifications

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether this package is currently available for assignment

fields.name: autoProvision
fields.description: Whether this package should be automatically assigned based on role/department match

constraints.uniquePackage: Combination of packageName, role, and department should be unique

dataModels.name: Department
dataModels.description: Store department information and configuration for onboarding workflows

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the department

fields.name: name
fields.description: Department name (e.g., Engineering, Sales, HR)

fields.name: managerId
fields.description: Reference to Employee who manages this department

fields.name: itContactId
fields.description: Reference to Employee who handles IT setup for this department

fields.name: standardEquipmentPackageId
fields.description: Reference to default equipment package from EquipmentCatalog

fields.name: onboardingDurationDays
fields.description: Standard number of days for department onboarding workflow

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether department is active and accepting new employees

dataModels.name: Document
dataModels.description: Manages employee documents submitted during onboarding with verification status and secure storage references

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the document

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee who submitted the document

fields.name: documentType
fields.description: Type of document (e.g., ID_PROOF, TAX_FORM, BANK_DETAILS, EMPLOYMENT_VERIFICATION)

fields.name: storageUrl
fields.description: Secure storage location reference or URL for the uploaded document

fields.name: verificationStatus
fields.description: Current verification status (e.g., PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED)

fields.name: rejectionReason
fields.description: Reason for rejection if document was not approved

fields.name: uploadedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the document was uploaded

fields.name: verifiedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the document was verified or rejected

relationships.description: Each document belongs to one employee

dataModels.name: EquipmentAssignment
dataModels.description: Tracks IT equipment assigned to employees including assignment dates, equipment details, and return status for asset management

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the equipment assignment

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee receiving the equipment

fields.name: equipmentCatalogId
fields.description: Reference to the equipment item from the catalog

fields.name: serialNumber
fields.description: Unique serial number or asset tag of the assigned equipment

fields.name: assignedDate
fields.description: Date when equipment was assigned to the employee

fields.name: returnDate
fields.description: Date when equipment was returned by the employee

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of the assignment (assigned, returned, damaged, lost)

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Additional notes about the assignment or equipment condition

relationships.description: Each assignment belongs to one employee
Each assignment references one equipment catalog item

dataModels.name: Credential
dataModels.description: Securely manages employee login credentials and access permissions with encrypted storage and expiry tracking

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the credential record

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee who owns this credential

fields.name: credentialType
fields.description: Type of credential (e.g., email, VPN, system_access, application)

fields.name: encryptedValue
fields.description: Encrypted credential data stored securely at rest

fields.name: generatedDate
fields.description: Date when the credential was generated

fields.name: expiryDate
fields.description: Date when the credential expires and requires renewal

fields.name: deliveryStatus
fields.description: Status of credential delivery (e.g., pending, delivered, failed)

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates whether the credential is currently active

relationships.description: Each credential belongs to one employee

constraints.encryptionRequired: encryptedValue field must be encrypted at rest using AES-256 or equivalent
constraints.credentialTypeValues: credentialType must be one of: email, vpn, system_access, application
constraints.deliveryStatusValues: deliveryStatus must be one of: pending, delivered, failed

fields.name: endDate

fields.name: status

routing.reasoning: Complex onboarding workflow with 9+ steps, multiple departments, parallel processing (IT/HR/Manager), conditional routing, auto-rejection logic, and sophisticated business rules. Requires advanced forms for document submission/verification with wizard flow for multi-step onboarding. SQL for structured employee data, relationships between users/roles/departments. Cross-platform mobile for accessibility across devices. High confidence due to clear complexity indicators and well-defined requirements.
